chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-Khazzāz narrated from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام.
That ʿAlī عليه السلام disliked that a man should feed others in the expiation of an oath before breaking it.

key_terms.كَفَّارَةِ: expiation or atonement required for a religious violation
key_terms.يُطْعِمَ: to feed, here meaning to provide food as expiation

ai.seo_question: Can kaffarah for a broken oath be given before the oath is actually broken?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarded it as disliked for a person to offer the feeding due in kaffarah for an oath before the oath has actually been broken. It indicates that the expiation is tied to the occurrence of the violation and should not ordinarily be advanced beforehand.
